_comment: Headless invocations for the agents under test. Flags checked 2026-10-14 against each agent's docs (pi docs/cli+json+models, omp package source, opencode.ai/docs/cli, docs.factory.ai droid-exec + BYOK); not yet exercised end to end. Placeholders: {prompt} {model} {baseUrl} {apiKey} {providerApi} {workdir} {promptFile} {outDir}. {providerApi} is the agent's name for the model profile's API (agent.apis[profile.api]); an agent without an entry for that API cannot run on that model. Files are written under the run's private HOME (~ = that HOME). `output` selects the stdout parser (src/agents/output.ts) that extracts the final report and token usage.

pi._apis: pi-ai api names. openai-responses against Router is UNVERIFIED.

omp._files: omp reads models.yml; YAML is a superset of JSON so the pi provider block is written as-is. Schema assumed identical to pi's (omp is a pi fork): verify on first run.
omp._apis: pi-ai api names. openai-responses against Router is UNVERIFIED.

opencode._apis: AI SDK provider package; @ai-sdk/openai calls the Responses API by default. Responses against Router is UNVERIFIED.

droid._modelRoute: customModels: droid talks to the shared DO endpoint like the other agents (decided). factory-native: Factory-hosted model, set factoryNativeModel and switch the command's --model.
droid._command: Custom model id = custom:<displayName with spaces→dashes>-<index in customModels>.
droid._apis: customModels provider; droid's 'openai' provider speaks the Responses API. Against Router UNVERIFIED.
droid._output: stream-json (switched 2026-10-14 from json, which carries only the final result: no tool calls for exec evidence, and an empty result with kimi-k2.6). Event shape UNVERIFIED; parsers are lenient (src/agents/output.ts, src/agents/transcript.ts).
droid._restrictTools: Allowlist (2026-10-14, user decision): coding tools only. Drops WebSearch, FetchUrl, ConnectorSearch (Slack/GitHub/... connectors), MCP servers, automations, missions, subagents, Skill and ToolSearch: these run through Factory's servers, a side channel around the no-internet VM. IDs are the model-facing names; checked with `droid exec --restrict-tools ... --list-tools` on local droid 0.232.0 (unknown IDs fail the run). Not yet run on the VM's droid 0.241.1.
droid._preflight: Run as the agent user on the same VM before the agent (no model call). Its output (tools with currentlyAllowed) is saved as preflight.json: the stream-json init event lists every registered tool even with --restrict-tools, so it cannot show what the model is offered.
droid._disabledTools: Denylist on top of the --restrict-tools allowlist (2026-10-14, user decision): integration/eval/automation tools from droid 0.241.1's init event, which --list-tools does not show. No documented flag disables integrations. Unknown IDs make droid exit with 'Unknown tool identifier'.
droid._cloudSessionSync: false: run transcripts are not mirrored to Factory web (default true).

lyd-agent._binary: Uploaded to /usr/local/bin/lyd-agent on each run VM ({arch} = x64|arm64 from the VM's uname -m), so lyd-agent changes need no snapshot rebuild. Build with agents/lyd-agent/build.sh. Not yet run on Linux.
lyd-agent._artifacts: Pulled after the run. {outDir} is outside {workdir}, but the model's bash can still write there, so the agent-reported exec log is self-reported evidence, kept alongside (not instead of) the root-side tracer/poller.

kimi-k3._note: Ramp Router, account 2 (separate credit from the Sonnet/judge account). Listed on all 4 Router accounts 2026-10-14. kimi-k3 over Router's Responses API is UNVERIFIED (Router has no chat/completions).

kimi-k3-do._note: DigitalOcean: credit removed 2026-10-14; kept for reference. DigitalOcean inference. The user's DO tier 403s all Claude/GPT models; other open-weight ids that answered 200 on 2026-10-14: deepseek-v4-pro, qwen3.8-max, mimo-v2.5-pro.

claude-sonnet-5-5._note: Ramp Router. Only /v1/responses exists (/v1/chat/completions is 404, checked 2026-10-14). Router returns usage.cost; account 1 also pays for Jev and the GPT judge; accounts 2-4 (ROUTER_API_KEY_2..4) are spare credit.

beam._note: Reflection AI beta (free; 100M tokens/day, 20k requests/day as of 2026-10-15). 1M context, 128K max output. OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions only; reasoning always on (default effort max); assistant messages must carry reasoning_content back; unknown params return 400. Chat API was 502 for hours on 2026-10-15. Not on Router, so outside the key pool.

_keyMode: edge: on Freestyle VMs the key is injected at the Freestyle edge as an Authorization header for the profile's baseUrl host, and the VM only sees a placeholder. env: the key is passed to the agent process (local smoke runs).
